title: Monkey in the Middle
description: Simulate monkeys inspecting and throwing items based on worry-level rules.
writeup:
## Approach

Parse each monkey's starting items, operation (e.g. `old * 19`), divisibility test, and target monkeys. Simulate rounds of item-throwing.

## Part 1

After each inspection, divide worry by 3 (integer division). Run 20 rounds. The answer is the product of the two highest inspection counts ("monkey business").

## Part 2

No more divide-by-3 relief, so worry levels explode. The key insight: since all tests are divisibility checks, we only need worry values modulo the product of all divisors. This keeps numbers manageable while preserving all test outcomes. Run 10,000 rounds.
